title: ARG Telemetry Cryptographic Signature
description: SHA-256 payload hash signed by the enforcement gate private key, making the audit ledger tamper-proof

payload_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the complete telemetry payload (context + lineage + evaluation blocks)

signature.description: Base64-encoded signature of payload_hash signed with the enforcement gate private key

key_id.description: Identifier of the signing key used. Must reference a key registered in your KMS.

signed_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the signature was applied

note: Key management is not optional. See community/key-management.md for key rotation, custody, and incident response requirements before production deployment.
